scope.interaction: interrupt the isolated owned server and reconnect

productLoss: The shared Composer control projection prioritized working over blocked, so a running session kept a clickable Stop action after the backend became unavailable.
A VCS status request canceled by the expected disconnect was logged as a renderer error even though the lifecycle recovered successfully.
The fix preserves the real running and Working state, disables only the unavailable primary action, and suppresses only disconnect-canceled VCS failures while retaining online VCS errors.
harnessMismatch: The original lifecycle verifier hard-coded connected and recovered Composer state to idle. The fixture carried a real running session, so readiness now requires the shell session, thread-detail session, and Composer semantic state to agree before interruption and after recovery.
classification.evidenceBoundary: This exact-bundle run verifies Native lifecycle content, session-derived Composer state, action availability, real reconnect interaction, transport, owned process identity, errors, and cleanup. It does not provide Native pixel parity.

failure.banner: T3 Code: Connection failed Server exited (code=null signal=SIGKILL). Reconnect Connections

reconnect.input: DevTool Input.emulateTouchFromMouseEvent on the measured Reconnect selector
reconnect.banner: T3 Code: Failed to connect. Reconnecting... Waiting for server… Reconnecting... Connections

validation.build: Lynx production build passed with existing unsupported-property and import.meta warnings
validation.agentBrowserLeakGate: Every loop preflight and postflight reported owned=0 orphaned=0

remainingRisk: Native material and pixel parity are not measured by this lifecycle run.
The reconnect action uses a measured DevTool tap rather than physical keyboard activation.
The active provider process represented by the restored running session is fixture state; no provider subprocess was resumed or interrupted.
